children: Olivier Pomel, a director and Chief Executive Officer, sold Class A common stock at a weighted-average price of $212.9041 per share for total proceeds of $5,605,977 and, following the transaction, directly owned 586,416 Class A common shares.

Le-Quoc Alexis, a director and Chief Technology Officer, sold Class A common stock at a weighted-average price of $212.9043 per share for total proceeds of $4,635,352 and, following the transaction, directly owned 488,033 Class A common shares and indirectly owned 169 Class A common shares held by the Alexis Le-Quoc Revocable Trust.

David M. Obstler, an officer serving as Chief Financial Officer, sold Class A common stock at a weighted-average price of $212.9041 per share for total proceeds of $3,518,027 and, following the transaction, directly owned 418,067 Class A common shares.

Adam Blitzer, an officer serving as Chief Operating Officer, sold Class A common stock at a weighted-average price of $212.9041 per share for total proceeds of $2,940,631 and, following the transaction, directly owned 249,959 Class A common shares.

Sean Michael Walters, an officer serving as Chief Revenue Officer, sold Class A common stock at a weighted-average price of $212.9039 per share for total proceeds of $2,890,170 for 13,575 shares sold and, following the transaction, directly owned 244,845 Class A common shares and indirectly owned 8 Class A shares by his son.

Li Yanbing, an officer serving as Chief Product Officer, sold Class A common stock at a weighted-average price of $212.9043 per share for total proceeds of $2,385,805 for 11,206 shares sold and, following the transaction, directly owned 263,146 Class A common shares.

Kerry Acocella, an officer serving as General Counsel and Secretary, sold Class A common stock at a weighted-average price of $212.9039 per share for total proceeds of $1,563,353, with sale prices reported in the range of $210.12 to $213.01, and, following the transaction, directly owned 120,523 Class A common shares.

David Galloreese, an officer serving as Chief People Officer, sold Class A common stock at a weighted-average price of $212.9045 per share for total proceeds of $1,015,341, with shares sold in the price range of $210.12 to $213.01, and, following the transaction, directly owned 116,431 Class A common shares.
